name: CIS Critical Security Controls
description: Prioritized safeguards for defending systems and networks against prevalent attacks, including the Governance function introduced with v8.1.

requirements.title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.description: Actively manage, track, and correct enterprise assets connected to the infrastructure.

requirements.title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.description: Actively manage, track, and correct software on enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Data Protection
requirements.description: Identify, classify, securely handle, retain, and dispose of data.

requirements.title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.description: Establish and maintain secure configuration processes for enterprise assets and software.

requirements.title: Account Management
requirements.description: Assign and manage authorization to credentials and accounts.

requirements.title: Access Control Management
requirements.description: Create, assign, manage, and revoke access credentials and privileges.

requirements.title: Continuous Vulnerability Management
requirements.description: Continuously evaluate and track vulnerabilities on enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Audit Log Management
requirements.description: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs to detect and recover from attacks.

requirements.title: Email and Web Browser Protections
requirements.description: Improve protections and detections for email and web browser attack vectors.

requirements.title: Malware Defenses
requirements.description: Prevent or control the installation, spread, and execution of malicious code.

requirements.title: Data Recovery
requirements.description: Establish and maintain data recovery practices sufficient to restore assets and data.

requirements.title: Network Infrastructure Management
requirements.description: Establish and maintain a secure network architecture and lifecycle process.

requirements.title: Network Monitoring and Defense
requirements.description: Maintain comprehensive network monitoring and defense.

requirements.title: Security Awareness and Skills Training
requirements.description: Establish and maintain security awareness and role-based skills training.

requirements.title: Service Provider Management
requirements.description: Evaluate service providers that hold enterprise data or support enterprise platforms.

requirements.title: Application Software Security
requirements.description: Manage the security life cycle of application software.

requirements.title: Incident Response Management
requirements.description: Establish and maintain an incident response program with defined roles and procedures.

requirements.title: Penetration Testing
requirements.description: Test the effectiveness and resiliency of enterprise assets and controls through periodic penetration testing.
